# TDPdf v1.29.7.0

**File > Print now has a Properties button next to the printer picker, reaching the selected printer's own advanced settings (paper tray, quality, color, duplex) — the same button every native Windows print dialog has, and ours didn't.**

## Printer Properties

TDPdf's Print dialog is a custom one with a real preview, not the stock Windows print dialog — which meant it never picked up the "Properties"/"Preferences" button that dialog normally puts next to the printer selector. That button opens the printer driver's own settings UI: paper tray, print quality, color management, duplex mode, and whatever else that specific driver exposes. There was no way to get to it from TDPdf at all. It's back, next to the printer dropdown, and opens the properties dialog for whichever printer is currently selected.
